scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.dev:emulators: node scripts/with-java.mjs --temp=dev firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-canvas --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.deploy: node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-env.mjs && node scripts/deploy-secrets.mjs && firebase deploy --only hosting:jigsaw,functions:jigsaw
scripts.deploy:functions: node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-env.mjs && node scripts/deploy-secrets.mjs && firebase deploy --only functions:jigsaw
scripts.android:sync: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run cap -- sync android
scripts.android:open: npm --prefix frontend run cap -- open android
scripts.ios:sync: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run cap -- sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm --prefix frontend run cap -- open ios
scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/with-java.mjs --temp=test firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-canvas-test "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
